'''Revenant vampyres''' are a type of monster that inhabits the [[Forinthry Dungeon]] along with all other [[revenants]].
The Forinthry Dungeon is a part of the [[Wilderness]] so it is possible to be attacked by other players here if opted into [[PvP]].

Like all revenants, they can restore lifepoints quickly, can cure themselves of poison, and react quickly to a player's protection [[prayer]]s. When below 50% health, revenant vampyres will "eat" to heal 850 lifepoints from their limited supply of food. For a full description of the healing mechanic see the [[Revenants#Overview|revenants]] page.

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

Revenant drops are not affected by [[luck]]. There are only two ways to increase the drop rate of revenant items—completion of the [[Wilderness achievements#Elite achievements|elite Wilderness achievements]], which gives a 5% increased chance for revenant drops, and [[revenant drop enhancer]]s, which give a 10% increased chance. Both boosts can be in effect at the same time.

==Trivia==
* Revenant vampyres weren't updated during the [[17 August]] [[2011]] [[graphical update]], while most other [[vampyres]] were.
* These monsters used to have the ability to inflict poison with their melee attacks on members' worlds (starting at 68 damage). This was removed in a hidden update.
* Revenant vampyres have the longest respawn time out of all the other revenants, despite having their respawn time adjusted on [[22 July]] [[2014]].
